native_resolution_truth: Wan2.2 official open models support up to 720P. A 1080 master derived from Wan2.2 is an upscale and is never classified as native Full HD.

runtime_gates.NATIVE_FULL_HD_VERTICAL: required when native FHD is claimed

stock_route: Review recognizable people, brands, private property, sensitive context, and attribution obligations before public release.
local_generation_route: Provide/connect a CUDA-capable runtime before certifying local generation.
Attest any conditional model license before commercial use.
publication: Approve the exact final master before publishing.

blocked_from_automatic_production.krea_free: mutable quota/rights; not stable for unattended $0 production
blocked_from_automatic_production.runway_free: plan/model availability cannot satisfy a persistent zero-cost SLO
blocked_from_automatic_production.ltx2_local: conditional license requires manual legal attestation
blocked_from_automatic_production.hunyuan15_local: territorial/use restrictions require manual legal attestation
blocked_from_automatic_production.capcut_free_editor: manual/freemium; not a reproducible autonomous backend

authorization_note: Architecture and technical keyless stock path are authorized. Live execution is determined dynamically by readiness evidence. Native-FHD AI generation is not authorized via Wan2.2 because official native output is at most 720P. Publication remains human-approved.
